svg.aria-label: The Polaris Code agent graph. Boxes Input, Load docs, Steer, Compact, Summarize, Prepare, Model, Retry, Fail, Run tools, Review, Answer; the token walks Input → Load docs → Steer → Compact → Prepare → Model → Review → Run tools → Steer → Compact → Prepare → Model → Retry → Model → Answer.
svg.title: The Polaris Code agent graph
svg.text: Each box is a step. The token walks one short task: a tool round, a failed model call that is retried, then the answer.
